europe_now.title: US Soldier Arrested in Britain Over Alleged Russian Espionage
europe_now.summary: British counterterrorism police arrested a US soldier in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence and spying on behalf of Russia. Federal authorities in the United States have formally charged three individuals over a related terror plot.

sources.headline: US soldier arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence
British counterterrorism police arrest US soldier accused of spying on behalf of Russia

europe_now.title: Ukraine and Russia Hold US-Mediated Talks in Abu Dhabi
europe_now.summary: Delegations from Ukraine and Russia are participating in a second consecutive day of US-mediated negotiations in Abu Dhabi. Discussions during the constructive meetings have included potential prisoner swap arrangements.

sources.headline: LIVE: Ukraine, Russia hold second day of US mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
Ukraine and Russia discuss prisoner swap deal during ‘constructive’ talks

top_stories.title: EU and UK Progress Toward Carbon Market Alignment
top_stories.summary: European Union and United Kingdom officials are nearing an agreement regarding carbon markets ahead of an upcoming summit in Dublin. The discussions involve the UK seeking preferential access to European regulatory frameworks.

sources.headline: EU‑UK carbon market deal close, with UK courting access to ‘Made in Europe’ before Dublin summit

top_stories.title: Spain Faces Housing Crisis Pressures Ahead of Elections
top_stories.summary: A general strike in Spain has thrust the national housing crisis into the center of upcoming political campaigns. Citizens and political figures continue to demand accountability and address economic strains related to housing costs and recent natural disasters.
